title: Sequence Feasibility + Dead-End Detection + Auto-Resequencing
description: Build the SequenceFeasibilityEngine that forward-simulates the operation sequence, checking all physical feasibility constraints at each step. Detect dead-ends where completing one operation makes a future operation impossible. Implement backtracking search with constraint propagation to find valid orderings or prove none exist.

units.title: SequenceFeasibilityEngine: forward simulation with accessibility, workholding, rigidity checks at each step
steps: simulate(): for each op in sequence: applyOperation → check ALL remaining ops for feasibility
Dead-end detection: if any remaining op fails accessibility, workholding, or rigidity → flag
Report format: 'After op N (rough pocket), op M (finish shelf) becomes impossible because tool cannot reach shelf through pocket walls'
Per-step checks: AccessibilityAnalysis + WorkholdingViability + RigidityDegradation for ALL remaining ops
Performance: cache IPW state at each step for backtracking without full recompute
riskScore(): Monte Carlo variation on uncertain parameters → P(success) per operation
findDeadEnds(): identify ALL dead-ends, not just the first one
exit_conditions: Forward simulation detects known dead-end scenario
20+ tests including dead-end, no-dead-end, and multi-dead-end scenarios

units.title: Auto-resequencing: backtracking search with constraint propagation to find valid orderings
steps: suggestReordering(): when dead-end found, search for valid orderings
Constraint propagation: prune impossible orderings early (e.g., roughing must precede finishing)
Backtracking with depth limit (max 1000 permutations for ≤15 ops)
If no valid ordering exists: report with explanation of conflicting constraints
Optimize valid orderings: among feasible sequences, pick best for cycle time/tool life
whatIf(): test impact of moving one specific operation
exit_conditions: Finds valid reordering for solvable dead-ends
Reports 'no solution' with explanation for unsolvable cases
